# harborpilot_budget (Data Source)

Looks up an existing budget by `id` or `name`. Secret values are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harborpilot_budget" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "spec" {
  value = jsondecode(data.harborpilot_budget.example.spec)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object id. Set `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Object name. Set `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `managed_by` (String)
- `revision` (Number)
- `secret_names` (Set of String) Names of secrets that are set.
- `spec` (String) Canonical specification as JSON; decode with `jsondecode`.
